name: web-figma-writeback
description: Reusable Codex plugin for rebuilding any implemented website back to editable Figma designs with design-system fidelity.

interface.shortDescription: Rebuild real webpages as editable Figma designs.
interface.longDescription: Capture a running website as the source of truth, then rebuild or update the matching Figma page as editable semantic nodes while reusing component libraries, variables, typography styles, colors, icons, images, and layout measurements. Screenshots are references only, not final page bodies. If no design system exists, create 01 Base, 02 Semantic, 03 Spacing, and 04 Typography foundations first.
defaultPrompt: Use $figma-page-sync to rebuild this website as editable Figma nodes.
Run the Figma design-system preflight first, then reuse components, variables, and typography styles.
Create only missing fallback variables/components, and do not use screenshots as the final page body.
